title: MiMo Halo state-tier snapshot receipt
description: Public contract for canonical receipts and index records emitted by mimo_halo.state_tier.store put and printed by inspect. Digest fields are SHA-256 hex and provide integrity only, not authenticity or signature. Identity fields are caller-supplied structural fingerprints: the store validates their structure and equality, never that any server or model actually loaded them.

snapshot_id.description: Deterministic identifier derived from namespace, session id and generation. At most one record exists per (namespace, session_id, generation).

session_id.description: Opaque logical-session identifier. Never used to build filesystem paths.

generation.description: Monotonic semantic state revision for the session. A repeated generation with different content or identity is refused.

token_count.description: Logical token count declared by the caller; metadata only, never raw tokens.

token_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the caller's token id sequence; metadata only.

state_sha256.description: SHA-256 of every serialized payload byte stored in the blob.

serialized_bytes.description: Actual payload bytes written and verified.

created_at.description: Unix seconds when the record was first published.

last_accessed.description: Unix seconds of the most recent successful put-reuse or get. Index metadata only; immutable blob bytes are never rewritten for access time or retention class.

blob_path.description: Store-relative immutable blob path confined under blobs/<namespace shard>/<content hash>.bin.

io_metrics.description: Honest per-operation write accounting. Present on every put receipt (and put stdout); per-operation, therefore not persisted in the index and absent from inspect output. Counts only payload blob bytes this put operation actually wrote: the full payload size when a new or healing blob was written, 0 when an existing verified blob was reused or deduplicated. Excludes SQLite/index writes, filesystem metadata, the receipt file itself, and NAND/SSD write amplification — it is not a device-level write claim.

payload_bytes_written.description: Payload-file bytes written to the store by the emitting put operation; 0 when that operation reused an existing verified blob.

identity.description: Compatibility identity, schema_version 1. Structure and equality only; not an attestation claim about any remote server.

runtime_patch_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the local patch set; hash of the empty patch set when none.

kv_config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical semantic cache config (RoPE, context, SWA, KV precision).

namespace.description: Opaque security principal ID. Isolation is enforced by identity equality on get, never inferred from filesystem layout.
